why.subtitle: Printed QR codes are permanent. Everything behind them shouldn't have to be.

items.title: No reprinting
items.desc: Fix a typo, swap a menu, or redirect a campaign — without touching the printed code.

items.title: You own your data
items.desc: Files live in your Google Drive account. Disconnect anytime and keep everything.

items.title: Free, honestly
items.desc: Core QR creation and analytics are free — no trial period, no surprise limits.

items.a: Yes. Creating dynamic QR codes, updating destinations, and viewing scan analytics are free.
In your own Google Drive account. Qonnect only stores a reference to the file and the QR routing info.

items.q: What happens if I disconnect Google Drive?
items.a: File-based QR codes will stop resolving until you reconnect, but your QR codes and settings aren't deleted.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes — add and verify a custom domain, and new QR links will use it instead of the default Qonnect domain.

items.q: Can I disable a QR code without deleting it?
items.a: Yes. Disabling a QR code stops it from resolving while keeping the code and its history intact.
